label: Calibrating a supervenience reply across selective histories (inference)
rule: Transfer the verdict and correctness from an accurate panel representative at the same factor value
meaning: The relation horn admits a restricted reply if correctness supervenes on the selected factor, verdicts stay fixed at each factor value, and a covering comparison panel is accurate. The transported result concerns the represented cases. Supervenience supplies neither the direction of calibration nor a causal explanation of selection.
